Several days of tasks (repeatable every 20 h) + 1–2 hours per Warzone

Gnomes and Dwarves have joined forces in the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub|Gnome Deep Hub} to face a threat from the depths. Do daily tasks for the Gnomes, Dwarves and Scouts until you have enough points, destroy a Fragile Lava Funnel and enter Warzones 4, 5 and 6 to defeat The Baron from Below, The Count of the Core and The Duke of the Depths. Defeating all three gives you the {wiki:Powerful Featherweight|Powerful Featherweight} imbuement, several achievements and access to the boss {creature:Ancient Spawn of Morgathla}.

You need all three pieces of the {item:Strange Mallet}; recommended team of 15 to 30 players.

The tasks can be done in any order and repeated every **20 hours**. Each task gives 1 point and 1 {item:Surprise Jar}; if you also complete the bonus objective, you get 1 more point and 1 more Surprise Jar.
You can see how many points you have by asking any of the three NPCs ({npc:Gnomus}, {npc:Klom Stonecutter} or {npc:Lardoc Bashsmite}) about {key:gnomes}, {key:dwarves} and {key:scouts}.
Accept the **Subterranean Life** task before the others: the Diremaws and Deepworms you kill in other areas also count.
**Fire damage heals every boss.** Mages: don't use fire spells (e.g. {spell:Hell's Core}, {item:Great Fireball Rune}). Paladins: don't summon the {creature:Emberwing}. Use ice and death.
Some lava pools can be walked on but deal **500 fire damage** per step: one or two steps will kill a mage or paladin. {item:Firewalker Boots} don't work here.
Before you start: reach the Gnome Deep Hub

The entrance to the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub} is in **Kazordoon**. There are two ways to get there:
1. **{wiki:Steamship}**: from {wiki:Cormaya} (near Edron, with {npc:Gurbasch}) or from **Farmine** (with {npc:Thorgrin}), say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes}. You arrive at Kazordoon's underground port, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.
2. **On foot**: through the mountain entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the way to the Kazordoon entrance}). Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}.

In Kazordoon, go to the Gnome Deep Hub entrance, near the blesser in the **north** of the city (4 floors below ground level), and enter. Alternatively, if you are level 80+, use the {wiki:Gnomish Crystal Teleport System|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}: access is given by {npc:Xelvar} in Kazordoon and each trip uses a {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp); the Kazordoon crystal is right next to the entrance. The hub is very far away, under the sea to the east; {npc:Gnomus} is just **north** of where you arrive.
Each faction opens a different Warzone and the tasks have no mandatory order:

You need **15 points** with a faction to enter its Warzone (**10** if you have already defeated the bosses of Warzones 1, 2 and 3 of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest). Each task gives 1 point (+1 with the bonus) and you can repeat each task every **20 hours**. You can also hand in {item:Suspicious Device|Suspicious Devices} to the NPC of your choice: each is worth 1 point.
To see your points, say {key:gnomes}, {key:dwarves} or {key:scouts} to any of the three NPCs.
{npc:Gnomus} is **north** of the Gnome Deep Hub entrance. He has three tasks.
Say {key:hello} and {key:help}. He offers three tasks: {key:ordnance}, {key:charting} and {key:measurements}.

Say {key:ordnance} and confirm with {key:yes}. You have to escort {creature:Lost Gnome|Lost Gnomes} (and, for the bonus, their {creature:Gnome Pack Crawler|Gnome Pack Crawlers}) to the cave's safe exit.

Go to the **easternmost** part of the hub and go down at this spot; then go up the next ramp. Head to the **southeast** of the cave, where there is what looks like a crystal teleport area. There you will find a {creature:Lost Gnome} and up to 3 {creature:Gnome Pack Crawler|Gnome Pack Crawlers}.

{npc:Klom Stonecutter} is **southeast** of the Gnome Deep Hub entrance. He has two tasks.
Say {key:hello} and {key:help}. The tasks are {key:home} (Home Improvement) and {key:subterraneans} (Subterranean Life).
Klom Stonecutter, southeast of the entrance

Say {key:subterraneans} and {key:yes}. You have to kill **50** {creature:Diremaw|Diremaws} and {creature:Deepworm|Deepworms}. Kills in other areas (for example in the Warzone 6 tasks area) also count, so accept this task before the others. It has no bonus. When you are done, go back and say {key:subterraneans}.
Say {key:home} and {key:yes}. You have to kill **20** {creature:Lost Exile|Lost Exiles} in the cave next door.
Home Improvement: destroy the houses and kill the Lost Exiles

The Lost Exiles have built {item:Makeshift Home|Makeshift Homes} and flee there before dying (they disappear and you get no loot, experience or task point). So **destroy the nearby Makeshift Homes first**: a Lost Exile with no home nearby fights to the death. In some areas (for example the northeast) destroying one home is enough to create an area where you can kill them. Luring them to the entrance or to the southern areas also works.
Dwarves' tasks area: the check marks are Makeshift Homes; the blue flag is a structure of the Uncharted Territory task

After destroying a Makeshift Home, use the rubble to try to make a prisoner, a {creature:Captured Dwarf}. If you succeed, it follows you and is immune to damage: take it out of the cave, to the border of the dwarves' outpost, **within the time limit** or it runs away. You need **3 prisoners** for the bonus. Then go back and say {key:home}.
1 point + Surprise Jar (+1 point and Surprise Jar with 3 prisoners)
{npc:Lardoc Bashsmite} is **northeast** of the Gnome Deep Hub entrance. He has two tasks.
Say {key:hello} and {key:work}. He talks about the {key:diremaws} (Pesticide task) and the {key:growth} (Explosive Growth task).
Lardoc Bashsmite, northeast of the entrance
Here too there is walkable lava that deals 500 fire damage per step (Firewalker Boots don't help).
Say {key:growth} and {key:yes}. You have to burn the sponges the Diremaws feed on in at least **3** of the **5** areas.

Go down the ramp **north** of Lardoc (careful with the lava) and come back up. Pull the lever to take an {item:Explosive Barrel (Quest)|Explosive Barrel} out of the storage and drag it to one of the 5 sponge areas. With the barrel in there, **use it** to set it on fire: it explodes after 5 seconds. Repeat in at least 3 areas (all 5 give the bonus). On the way you map the **Outpost** and the **Bastion** for the Uncharted Territory task, if you have it. Go back and say {key:growth}.
Using the Explosive Barrel in the first room
The barrel's explosion can deal **1000 fire damage** if you are very close (the dangerous radius is much smaller than the animation suggests).
1 point + Surprise Jar (+1 point and Surprise Jar with all 5 areas)

Take {item:Gnomish Pesticides} from a chest near Lardoc and enter the cave. Use the pesticide on **20** dead {creature:Diremaw|Diremaws}. It only works **10 seconds after** the Diremaw dies (when the body can be moved). When you use the pesticide, an angry Diremaw may appear to protect the eggs. Then go back to Lardoc to hand it in.

Once you have the required points with a faction, enter the energy portal near that faction's tasks area and destroy one of the three {item:Fragile Lava Funnel|Fragile Lava Funnels}. This gives you access to the Warzone (the points are deducted). The Warzone entrances are around the hub: **Warzone 4** to the **east**, **Warzone 5** to the **south** and **Warzone 6** to the **northeast**.
**Each player** has to destroy a funnel for each Warzone.
The access doesn't expire until you enter the Warzone, so each player can (and should) destroy the funnel before the time agreed with the team.

After you pass the Warzone teleport for the first time, you have **8 hours** of access (you can leave and come back as many times as you like). If the 8 hours run out while you are inside you are not kicked out, but if you leave you can only get back in by destroying another funnel and spending more points.

Inside the Warzone there are big blue crystals: use them to mine {item:Heavy Crystal Fragment|Heavy Crystal Fragments}. There are small, medium and large crystals; the larger ones give better chances. The team needs **30 fragments** to open the boss room.

The 3 Warzone bosses always drop 5 Heavy Crystal Fragments for each player who took part. If you go from one boss to the next, pick them up from the corpse and you avoid mining in the next Warzone. The crystals disappear after 24 hours, but they stay saved in the depot for the first Warzone next time.

Each boss has a **4-hour** cooldown, so you can kill it at most 3 times during the 8 hours of access (for the third time you have to enter the Warzone before the access runs out and wait for the cooldown). There is no lever and no player limit in the fight. If the team enters the boss room and doesn't kill it, they are kicked out after about 17 minutes (in that case there is no cooldown and they can try again straight away).
Team enters the room and leaves without killing the boss

Team enters, doesn't kill the boss and waits to be kicked out by the timer (~17 min)
No cooldown: they can go straight back in through the teleport

With the 30 fragments, go to the {item:Hollow Geode} in the **southwest** of the Warzone. Use the {item:Heavy Crystal Fragment|Heavy Crystal Fragments} on it: the {item:Stalagmites} next to it turn into a teleport.
The teleport is only active for **8 seconds** and can't be reopened while anyone is in the boss room. Have the whole team ready and standing next to it.

Attack {creature:The Baron from Below} to start. After a few seconds it turns into {creature:The Hungry Baron from Below}, teleports to the centre of the room (trapping it in the corners doesn't work) and an {creature:Organic Matter} appears. **The whole team kills the Organic Matter as fast as possible**, otherwise the Hungry Baron eats it and recovers half of its maximum health. When it dies, 4 {creature:Aggressive Matter|Aggressive Matters} appear: kill them quickly (preferably with area attacks) and go back to the boss.
After every change of form you have to target the boss again.

The 4 {item:Lava Hole|Lava Holes} in the room activate one at a time for about 4 seconds and explode for ~1500 fire damage (area equal to a {item:Great Fireball Rune}). Keep the {creature:Aggressive Lava|Aggressive Lavas} away from the boss: their fire heals it.

After killing the boss, leave through the teleport to its Lava Pump room and use it to destroy it. Then go back the same way through the Warzone to the Gnome Deep Hub (you can re-enter the Warzone while the 8 hours of access last).
With the 30 fragments, go to the {item:Hollow Geode} in the **northeast** of the Warzone and use the fragments on it. The Stalagmites next to it turn into a teleport.
The teleport is only active for **8 seconds** and can't be reopened while anyone is in the boss room.

{creature:The Count of the Core} is also healed by fire. In the room there are 5 sets of aligned {item:Obsidian Pipes} that fire a wave of fire to the other side of the room, healing the boss and dealing a lot of damage. Block them by throwing {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls} in front of them. With this strategy you can trap the boss in the **southeast corner**, and one or two players are in charge of renewing the Magic Walls when the pipes are about to fire (they glow for a few seconds beforehand).
Obsidian Pipes glowing: they will fire in a few seconds

Whenever the boss takes damage, {creature:Snail Slime|Snail Slimes} appear. Kill them **away from the boss**: if they die close by, the Count is healed and players take about 1000 damage for every Slime that dies. The easiest way is for a second blocker to use {spell:Challenge} on them and pull them away, and the team kills them from a distance with {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes}.

The {creature:Ember Beast|Ember Beasts} make the Count stronger when they die, whether they are close or not (*"The count absorbs the power of the beast and becomes stronger"*). Try to block them without hitting them, although it is normal for them to die when you attack the Slimes.

After killing the boss, leave through the teleport to the Lava Pump room and use it to destroy it. Then go back the same way through the Warzone to the Gnome Deep Hub (you can re-enter the Warzone while the 8 hours of access last).
With the 30 fragments, go to the {item:Hollow Geode} in the **centre** of the Warzone and use the fragments on it. The Stalagmites next to it turn into a teleport.
The teleport is only active for **8 seconds** and can't be reopened while anyone is in the boss room.

During the fight, {creature:The Duke of the Depths} becomes invincible ({creature:The Fire Empowered Duke}) and {creature:Fiery Heart (Creature)|Fiery Hearts} appear at 5 fixed spots in the centre of the room. **Kill them all quickly** so the boss becomes vulnerable again. If they don't die in time, they turn into {creature:Fiery Blood|Fiery Bloods}, very strong fire elementals that you also have to kill.

Split the mages into two groups that alternate their final energy/ice spells to hit all the Fiery Bloods, while the other attackers use area spells and runes. The faster you kill the Fiery Hearts, the longer the boss stays vulnerable until it summons them again.

A single knight can trap and block the boss in the **east** of the room, near the teleport. This blocker should be a high level: while invincible the Duke becomes much stronger and lands combos of over 4000 damage, so at least two Druids should heal the main blocker. Other knights can block the {creature:Aggressive Lava|Aggressive Lavas} that keep appearing.
**Don't attack the Duke while he is invulnerable**: he answers with strong waves. His Beam and Wave have a large area, so everyone should be careful with their positioning.
After killing the boss, destroy its Lava Pump. Then go back the same way through the Warzone to the Gnome Deep Hub (you can re-enter the Warzone while the 8 hours of access last).
Featherweight and Death in the Depths

After defeating all three bosses (Baron, Count and Duke) and destroying the three Lava Pumps, you automatically gain access to the {wiki:Powerful Featherweight|Powerful Featherweight} imbuement and the achievement **Death in the Depths**.
After defeating the 3 Warzone bosses you can fight the {creature:Ancient Spawn of Morgathla}. Recommended team: 15 to 30 players.
Put together the three pieces of the mallet
You need the three pieces of a {item:Strange Mallet}. Only **one** player on the team needs to have them.
Use the {item:Huge Red Crystal} on the ground right beneath {npc:Gnomus} to be teleported to the room of the NPC {npc:Gnominimus}.
The wiki doesn't describe the exit from Gnominimus' room: if you need to go back to the hub before the fight, go back the way you came.
The player with the pieces says {key:hi}, {key:mallet} and {key:yes}. Gnominimus assembles the {item:Strange Mallet}.

With the whole team ready, the player with the mallet uses the {item:Strange Mallet} on the {item:Gong}. The message *"BOOOOOOOONG!"* appears and the stone next to it turns into a {item:Magic Forcefield}. Everybody go in quickly: it only stays open for **14 seconds**.
The Strange Mallet breaks and disappears when used. Only use it when everyone is ready.

The fight has 4 phases, each in a different room and each harder than the last. First, lots of {creature:Burrowing Beetle|Burrowing Beetles} appear (stronger than normal scarabs, but easy to kill; they still hit quite hard). Position the team in a corner of the room so as to protect the more fragile players (paladins and lower-level mages).
Next to the **east** wall, with {item:Wild Growth Rune|Wild Growths} protecting the flanks
In the 2nd room, the team can stay next to the west wall
In the 3rd room, the team can stay next to the north wall
In the final room, the team stays next to the east wall and uses Wild Growths to protect the flanks

When the beetles stop appearing, the {creature:Ancient Spawn of Morgathla} shows up. At first it is immune and heals itself if you hit it. To make it vulnerable, lure it onto one of the room's crystals **while they are glowing a darker blue**. From then on it takes damage: mages use {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes} and everyone focuses only on the boss.
In the first 3 rooms you hit it until it flees to the next room; it only dies in the last one. Only the damage from the last phase counts for the {wiki:Bosstiary|Bosstiary}.

In every room there are {item:Sulphur Geysir|Sulphur Geysers} that deal earth damage around them (the area grows every turn, up to 1500). From the 2nd room on there are also Obsidian Pipes that, when they start to glow, explode for **2500 fire damage**. Added to the boss's damage, you can take over 5000 at once.

After killing it, enter the teleport to the **north** (don't stay in the boss room: the geysers keep exploding). Open the chest to get the achievement **Scourge of Scarabs**. There are three different reward rooms:
{item:Bag} with 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, 1 {item:Gnomish Supply Package}, 1 {item:Rusted Armor} and 1 {item:Piggy Bank}
{item:Bag} with 50 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, 2 {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}, 1 {item:Slightly Rusted Armor} and 1 {item:Piggy Bank}
{item:Bag} with 2 {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, 4 {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}, 1 {item:Slightly Rusted Armor}, 1 {item:Slightly Rusted Legs} and 1 {item:Piggy Bank}
Scourge of Scarabs achievement + room reward

After the reward rooms or after a Warzone boss, go back the same way to the hub (from the Warzones: through the Lava Pump room and along the Warzone path). From the hub, leave through the entrance to **Kazordoon**. To leave Kazordoon, take the {wiki:Steamship} from {npc:Brodrosch} ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), use the crystal teleport next to the hub entrance, or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
The wiki doesn't describe a separate exit from the reward rooms of the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla: if you can't find an exit, go back the way you came in.
Unlike the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest|Bigfoot's Burden Quest}, you don't have to do the Warzones in order.
The NPCs treat you slightly differently if you have the maximum rank in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest, but the keywords are the same.
Equipment: fire protection in all Warzones; use ice and death damage. For Morgathla, earth protection (beetles and geysers) and fire protection (pipes).
